research.title: Systematic Factor Modeling
research.description: Numerical foundations for systematic factor analysis.

research.title: Identifiability and Spectral Recovery of Weak Factors in High-Dimensional Financial Systems
research.description: Analytical and reproducible numerical investigation of weak-factor identifiability in high-dimensional Gaussian spiked covariance systems, including Marchenko-Pastur spectral boundaries, BBP separation thresholds, asymptotic eigenvector alignment, and finite-sample Monte Carlo recovery.
